You (and your family) will be picked up at the airport or train station and will be taken to your new house. Onboarding: we’ll advise you on how to set up a Dutch bank account, apply for health insurance, getting a Dutch BSN number, registering at a dentist and general practitioner and other useful or necessary cases to arrange. We organize a few social gatherings in the year with all Xelvin employees and recruited engineers. Strong problem-solving skills and an ability to work well with internal and external stakeholders.
